seal.statement: Every promotion refusal measured on 2026-09-19 at four voters on two nodes reads a closure-refreshed priority summary that says satisfied, and the guard-input payload names which summary won but never why: the closure evidence owner can take a retained witness from the priority-recovery planning snapshot outright, build one from the node's own replica-operation and service rows through the decision snapshots, or produce none, and neither the route nor the reason the witness read satisfied is observable. The recorded refusal cannot be explained through the built route by one consistent services snapshot - a target row that made the in-flight ADD satisfying would appear in the same refusal's voter census, and it does not - so the route is the first live input a reproduction lacks. This quest makes it observable without changing it. The count-check payload, on every refusal and on the first passing check, states from the one evaluation that decided: the closure evidence route (retained, built or none); the witness state, whether the summary's spread was still pending, and the witness's unresolved semantic state ids and blocked partition ids; for this partition, where the decision snapshots exist, its semantic state, its spread-completion reason code and each satisfying operation's id, target node and target visibility state; and the base summary the closure choice was made against - its satisfied flag, its source and whether this partition was blocked in it. Where a value does not exist on the route taken, the payload says so rather than omitting it. No decision, schedule, retry cadence, log message text or existing log field changes.

text: The closure evidence owner now states which of its three routes it took, and the derivation records that route with the evidence behind it beside the summary it chose, so the count-check payload says WHY the summary it read said satisfied. buildPriorityRecoveryClosureEvidence returns priorityRecoveryClosureRoute (retained, built or none) on the object the derivation destructures and discards - no candidate, answer, summary or row gained a field. The derivation's BASE choice now goes through choosePriorityPartitionSummaryBase, which is chooseMoreAdvancedPriorityPartitionSummary's own choice plus which side won (published_normalized or derived), and the final closure choice hands priority-partition-summary-source.js the route, the witness object, the decision snapshots and the base summary of that same evaluation. That module's WeakMap value grew from a string to a frozen record of references; readPriorityPartitionSummarySource still returns record.source. The guard passes its own partitionId on the priority-recovery record it already builds, and the renderer adds one closure block: route, witnessMatchesAnswer, the witness (state, summarySpreadPending, capped unresolvedSemanticStateIds and blockedPartitionIds), this partition's row of the decision snapshots (semanticState, spreadCompletion.reasonCode, capped satisfying operations with targetNodeId and targetVisibilityState) and the base summary (satisfied, its own source, thisPartitionBlocked). Every absent case is an explicit named state in the field itself (unavailable_no_closure_choice_recorded, unavailable_no_closure_witness, unavailable_on_retained_route, unavailable_no_decision_snapshots, unavailable_partition_not_tracked), so the shape never changes with the route. Six witnesses: three routes reached through the real derivation and end to end through a real ControlPlaneReadinessService seeded with the recorded refusal's rows (route built, witness closure_satisfied_stale_publication, this partition spread_satisfied_in_flight because op-0's target is active_operational, base summary still blocking it, budget 0); the payload's witness and per-partition blocks; the absent cases; and a frozen oracle of main's own output on f9d388499 - the sha256 of the whole candidate, of the row the publication writer persists from it, and its priorityPartitionSummaryChanged flag - over all four cases.

round 1 REJECT (1 blocking). B1 one-evaluation / statement 'for this partition ... its semantic state': the renderer takes snapshots[0] of the unfiltered per-operation list as the partition's semantic state, while the witness owner filters conflicts and selects one representative per partition; with two operations on a partition (an ADD gone terminal beside a queued ADD - the very moment learners pass) the payload states blocked_unclassified where the witness used recovering_in_flight, and witnessMatchesAnswer stays true; about 65 of 20000 partition reads per seed, 24 of 240 minimal two-operation row sets. Scope, measured: spreadCompletion (reason code, satisfying operation ids) never differed across a partition's entries in 60000 reads, and the error never crossed the satisfied/unresolved boundary in 56000 reads, so the refusal readings - route, witness state, satisfying operations with their target node and visibility, base summary - are not corrupted. Neutrality holds: 6000-case pure differential and five 2300-step real-owner traces byte-identical to main's incl. six memo counters and publication row bytes; no steady leak over 6001 derivations (retention amplification bounded: decision snapshots live as long as a held summary). Non-blocking: the admitted last-writer-wins aliasing does not exist (the normalizer always returns a fresh object; records are written once) and two code comments describe a mechanism that cannot happen; witnessMatchesAnswer can only be false for a copied or merged witness and no witness drives it false; capList throws on a non-iterable truthy list and the new witness id lists reach it unguarded (not reachable today); the satisfying-operations cap is unwitnessed. Confirmed in code: the guard's synchronous path can never read a retained witness (readPublicationPlanningSnapshotSync nulls priorityRecoveryPlanningSnapshot after the options spread; both readiness-service entries defer nested planning), so the retained route lives only on the coordinator's reconcile, reads and heartbeat paths.

What this quest was for, and what it delivered before it was stopped. Six lab formations on its staged round-1 tree (scratch commit ab5e9dbfd, refs/lagrange-scratch/witness-route) answered the question it was opened for: all 1091 refusals take the built route, and the one satisfying operation targets a node that already holds a voter - the spread completion double counts a holder (sixth addendum of 2026-09-19). The rejected field (the per-partition semantic state) is not part of that reading; the verifier measured that the satisfying-operation readings are unaffected. The owner's repair (quests critical-spread-transition-authority-carry and critical-spread-transition-authority) deletes the priority-summary read from the promotion guard, and with it the payload block this quest adds, so a second round would polish observability that is about to be removed.

Purpose served and the surface is about to be deleted: the route question is answered by lab formations on the staged tree, the verifier rejected round 1 on a field outside that answer, and the authority repair removes the guard's summary read together with this payload block. Nothing of it lands; the staged tree is kept at refs/lagrange-scratch/witness-route.
